name: mtownsend/xml-to-array
input_api: XmlToArray::convert(string $xml, bool $outputRoot = false) (the README's documented entry point; the global xml_to_array() helper forwards to it), called with $outputRoot = true. It loads the string with DOMDocument::loadXML and default options, then walks the DOM from documentElement into a PHP array; '@root' holds the root tagName
parser_family: libxml2 via PHP ext/dom DOMDocument::loadXML; shared with the standard DOMDocument path, symfony/dom-crawler and symfony/serializer
package_own_scope: XmlToArray's DOM-to-array mapping: tagName keys, grouping same-named siblings into lists and unwrapping single children, trimmed text and CDATA as strings, '@content' next to '@attributes' for text-only elements with attributes, attribute values keyed by DOMNamedNodeMap iteration key, and the optional '@root' entry. Tokenizing, well-formedness, entity and character-reference decoding, CDATA and namespace binding are libxml2.
family: libxml2 via PHP DOMDocument, shared with the standard path, symfony/dom-crawler and symfony/serializer

popularity.caveat: Cumulative downloads of the whole package, rank 30 in the snapshot's 'xml' query. The package's only function is XML-to-array conversion, but downloads count installs (often transitive, e.g. through the author's Laravel request/response XML packages), not XML-decoding uses. It shares the libxml2 parser family with the standard DOMDocument path, symfony/dom-crawler and symfony/serializer.

caveats: convert() returns no namespace information. Element keys and '@root' are DOM tagName values (prefix:local); attribute keys come from iterating DOMElement::attributes, whose keys are local names, so c:lang and p:currency appear as lang and currency; xmlns declarations are not attributes in the DOM and are absent. Neither control's four namespace URIs appears anywhere in the raw arrays (checked by the overlay build), the order control's <plain xmlns=""> undeclaration is invisible, and two attributes with the same local name in different namespaces would collapse into one key. The adapter reports these keys as returned; the oracle therefore parses without namespace processing and strips attribute prefixes rather than resolving namespaces.

Same-named siblings are grouped into one list keyed by name and single children are unwrapped, so document order is recoverable only when same-named siblings are adjacent (true for both controls). Comments, processing instructions and whitespace-only text are dropped. Values stay strings.

Each element keeps at most one text string: a later non-empty text or CDATA child overwrites an earlier one, and (by source reading, not run) text before a child element turns the element into a string, so assigning the child then fails with a PHP Error. Both controls have text-only or element-only content.
loadXML runs with default options and convert() checks no error: on malformed input libxml2 warnings are emitted and documentElement is null. Only the two valid controls were run.

Xdebug covers 40 XmlToArray.php lines on catalog-ns.xml and 39 on order-default-ns.xml (43 and 42 package lines with helpers.php); 1 differs (62, the '@content' wrap for a text-only element with attributes). AFL++ feedback comes from a native overlay that runs the same convert harness on PHP 8.5.12 and libxml2 2.15.4 with only libxml2 parser.c, parserInternals.c, SAX2.c and PHP ext/dom/document.c instrumented: 1096/1218 tuples over 5 identical repeats, all 360 differing tuples also differ under a bare default-option loadXML, and the 2 post-parse tuples are the same for both controls. XmlToArray's own lines do not reach the AFL++ map; the parser family is shared with the standard DOMDocument path, symfony/dom-crawler and symfony/serializer.
